changelog: Aura AI v2.2.3 — True Edge-to-Edge Floating Composer, Soft Unclipped Shadow & Voice Mode Polish
True Edge-to-Edge Navigation Bar: window.isNavigationBarContrastEnforced disabled and navigationBarColor set to transparent for true system bar transparency
Full Viewport Scroll: Chat content glides smoothly behind the floating composer and through the gesture navigation bar with soft translucent fade
Soft Unclipped Pill Shadow: Ambient & spot dual-layer elevation with clip=false matching top toggle & drawer buttons with zero corner clipping
Strict Mode-Scoped Scroll Button: Scroll-to-bottom down-arrow strictly hidden when switched to Voice Mode
